joint_slo.basis: Same predeclared exploratory thresholds as normal_capacity/session-r01; not a production SLO. No threshold selected from completion-handoff outcomes.

fixed.admission: native FCFS, cap256 in every arm
fixed.B_COMPLETION_FINALIZE: Original native finalization; completion adapter not installed
fixed.workload_sha256_semantics: Canonical JSON hash checked by the original input loader; distinct from the serialized file hash below.
fixed.transfers: Original native submission, completion observation, streams, handlers, buffers, reference counts and release paths unchanged.
fixed.warmup: original short32x16, short32x32, long2x2, output16; independent empty caches in every cell
fixed.observations: Original normal-capacity recovery-order observer and native host snapshots; no completion-handoff adapter, no additional CUDA query or synchronization.
fixed.arrival_sequence: Same256 distinct natural article prefixes, alternating3072/512,0.1s source-order arrivals; output limits768/1280 respectively, natural EOS

termination.actual_output_tokens: determined by natural EOS and per-request cap

selection: Exactly one native cell; no candidate arm, conditional expansion, tuning or workload sweep.
scope: Native-only natural-EOS discovery of legal ready-task waiting near capacity turnover. Only per-request output caps change: long-context768/short-context1280, average1024 and total cap262144. Actual output count is not fixed. No cross-workload performance or quality claim. GPU_UNRUN.

deployment.gpu_name: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition
deployment.runtime: Retained original package and model cache; native model runner/mixin/worker/scheduler/KV manager hashes match; private torch CPU imports passed with CUDA uninitialized.
deployment.comparison_scope: One native discovery cell on the same GPU; no cross-workload latency control or claimed gain.

source_basis: Original normal_capacity/run_cell.py with byte-identical cap256 prompts and arrivals; original source hashes pinned by mixed_turnover/run_group.py
execution_note: Original normal cell, warmups and observations. Reuse frozen blocking flock plus first-only30s handoff settle; hold shared lock for the whole native cell including warmups.
